verdict: Leads are coming in, but rising costs and overdue deliverables need resolution.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 126 leads at a cost of $6.55 per lead, entirely through Meta. In the most recent 7 days, daily spend rose to $35.84 with no corresponding increase in leads, pushing the short-term cost per lead up roughly 37% — ad pacing is being reviewed and corrective adjustments are in motion this week. A number of setup milestones originally due in July and August remain incomplete, including landing pages, CRM migration, and Google search campaigns; these are being escalated and worked through in priority order. Website session tracking is also being repaired, as conversion data is not recording correctly and currently under-reports activity. Next period, you should expect more consistent daily ad pacing and a clearer picture of website conversions as tracking is resolved.
